theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

top_news.title: Taiwan’s Currency Weakens Past 33 Per US Dollar on AI Jitters
top_news.summary: The Taiwan dollar weakened past the key psychological level of 33 per US dollar for the first time since April 2025, as a broad retreat in artificial intelligence shares weighed on the island’s tech-heavy equity market.

top_news.title: AI Slump Deepens as Taiwan Drops Most in a Year: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian stocks slumped, with tech bellwether Taiwan dropping the most in more than a year, extending a post-election rout in chipmakers that deepened on Wall Street on growing concern that Democrats will seek tighter regulation of the artificial intelligence industry.

top_news.title: OCBC CEO Raises Outlook as Lending Nudges Profit Higher
top_news.summary: Oversea-Chinese Banking Corp.’s profit edged up in the third quarter but gains in net interest income and wealth were dented by smaller contributions from trading and insurance.

top_news.title: Copper Moves Lower as US Election Undermines AI and Tariff Trade
top_news.summary: Copper slumped to its lowest since July as a political shakeup in Washington threatened to blunt two key bullish drivers: the rapid buildout of AI infrastructure, and the risk of US import tariffs on the metal.

top_news.title: Korea’s Kospi Tumbles Below 5,000 Milestone as AI Fears Spread
top_news.summary: South Korean chip stocks plummeted, pushing the equity benchmark below a key milestone, as fears deepened over how the Democrat sweep of Congress could slow the artificial intelligence buildout.

top_news.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 6
top_news.summary: Brent oil was on track for its biggest weekly loss since April 2020 after a volatile stretch of trading, as investors weighed prospects for an end to the months-long war in the Middle East.

top_news.title: Japan’s Nikkei Poised to Enter Bear Market as AI Selloff Deepens
top_news.summary: Japan’s Nikkei 225 Stock Average slumped Friday, putting the tech-heavy gauge on course to enter a technical bear market as investors unwind artificial intelligence-related trades.

top_news.title: Election Night TV Viewers Rise With NBC in Lead, Fox Falling
top_news.summary: An estimated 31.2 million people watched primetime news coverage of the 2026 midterm elections across 13 TV networks, according to Nielsen data.

top_news.title: Why Antipodes Portfolio Manager Is Betting on Disney
top_news.summary: Portfolio manager Vihari Ross of Antipodes Partners explains why Disney is a "genuine value opportunity" amid AI and disruption. She spoke on the sidelines of the Sohn Hearts & Minds conference in Queenstown, New Zealand. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Hedge Funds Tout Disney, ASML at Sohn Queenstown Conference
top_news.summary: Stock pickers pitched a Japanese confectionary maker and a Canadian gold miner at the annual Sohn Conference in Queenstown, New Zealand.
